objective: Ship This as a Finished Product.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Shared CETA services and scope isolation
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA supplies managed cognition/AI, identity, policy, persistence, observation, delivery and recovery to cooperating consumers. Shared installation versus project state has material isolation, resource and blast-radius consequences. This is the authorized CETA platform, not a mandate to inventory or govern other local repositories.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Consumers, shared services, tenancy, configuration and contracts
Control/data/management planes, authority, quotas and protected boundaries
Failure, accessibility, compatibility, migration, support and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep platform defaults, application/project configuration, governance policy, installation metadata and user data distinct. Shared services do not become rival authority. Enforce exact consumer scope, quotas, revocation and privacy, and preserve stop/evidence/recovery under noisy-neighbor or provider/resource failure. Actual consumer inventory, capacity, isolation and service commitments remain unproven.
source_inspections.reopening_condition: Material change to consumer, host/node, cloud/provider/channel, topology, scope, identity, contract, data, threat, policy, clock, model, evidence or lifecycle assumption.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Supported local host and infrastructure dependencies
source_inspections.decision_reason: The product depends materially on Windows compute, local storage, power, OS controls, model resources, configuration, credentials, backups and recovery. An existing machine or resource inventory is not a qualified infrastructure baseline.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Resources, placement, topology, owners, provisioning and configuration
Failure domains, security, physical constraints and recovery
Evidence, maintenance, replacement and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Separate desired configuration, provisioned resources and observed behavior. Treat host/storage/power/credential/image/model and evidence-store loss explicitly; consistent backup and restore include actual journaling files and compatibility. No facility, energy, capacity, physical control or hardware resilience claim is invented. Installation and destructive machine changes remain distinct from reversible development.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Provider-facing acquisition and delivery; offline runtime boundary
source_inspections.decision_reason: ARCH-01 declares a local product without a new mandatory cloud dependency; SPEC-22 forbids implicit external inference. Provider-backed artifact acquisition, release/update channels or expressly selected future provider integrations nevertheless require bounded provider, data, identity, cost, exit and recovery decisions. No cloud account, region, hosted runtime or live distribution service is inferred.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Provider scope, service/dependency identity, data and support assumptions
Authority, egress, integrity, substitution and recovery
Qualification, migration, exit and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Cloud workload/control-plane deployment is not activated in this local engineering scope. Preserve scoped optional acquisition and an offline asset route; provider loss must not redirect private context or start cloud inference. If a provider/channel is selected, resolve actual terms, accounts/regions, data transfer, residency, cost, isolation, support, deletion and exit with evidence before activation. Reopen on any hosted service, cloud data flow, identity or external publication decision.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Near-user local processing and offline authority
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA processes and stores data near its user and must operate offline, with local physical exposure, clocks, policy freshness, constrained resources and recovery. The source applies without requiring an IoT fleet, remote control plane or invented central service.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Local node/workload, user, physical and dependency scope
Local authority, freshness, privacy, identity and synchronization distinctions
Offline/update/degraded recovery, qualification and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Local operation cannot extend expired grants or use cache/model/operator labels to bypass current policy. Preserve local stop, status, evidence and recovery; clock drift, stale authority, disconnected resources, restore and update rollback require real tests. No central state exists by inference; actual distributed CBCC authorities retain their own boundaries. Site/physical controls, attestation and safe field-operation claims remain unqualified.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Process-boundary failures and genuine distributed authority
source_inspections.decision_reason: The design crosses helper process/time/trust boundaries and requires independently administered CBCC domains. Delay, partial failure, stale state, duplication, partition and concurrency are material even on one machine. No approved topology or universal exactly-once semantics is assumed.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Topology, actors, clocks, ownership, messages and consistency
Admission, ordering, replay, expiry, effects and compensation
Privacy, migration, fault evidence, operations and continuity

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Define per-message identity/causality, generations, bounded delivery, timeout, retry, deduplication and authority expiry. Receipt loss remains indeterminate; replay cannot repeat effects; compensation needs fresh current authority. Collocated helpers/simulations do not establish independent administrators, quorum resilience or hardware trust. Backpressure and model/observer/store/network failures must preserve stop/reconciliation capacity. The framing codec proves no distributed correctness.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Allowed paths, reachability and explicit egress
source_inspections.decision_reason: Artifact acquisition, optional integrations, loopback paths, worker restrictions and distributed protection have material reachability, exposure, identity, interception and lifecycle consequences. Offline-first operation does not remove the need to control network paths.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Endpoints, zones, flows, dependencies and intended/observed topology
Identity, authorization, privacy, exposure and cryptographic controls
Congestion, naming/certificate loss, recovery and lifecycle evidence

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Keep DNS, proxies, loopback, intranet/internet, certificates, routes, egress and telemetry in the declared resource profile. No public listener, arbitrary any-to-any access, broad firewall exception or new hosted endpoint is inferred. Select and qualify the actual local transport and permitted external flows before activation. Reachability, ping, policy files and this byte codec do not prove secure connectivity. Network loss must not trigger external-model fallback.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Owner conversation, notifications and machine communications
source_inspections.decision_reason: The Companion, native controls, status, instructions, consent, tool requests and future interface modalities exchange consequential human and machine messages. Delivery, interpretation, identity, accessibility, correction and privacy affect outcomes.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Audience, purpose, content, channel, identity and message state
Consent, authorization, timing, accessibility, privacy and records
Quality, failure, correction, validation and continuity

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Distinguish source/template/generated draft/approved content/transmission/receipt/response/evidence. Fluent text, an open signal or receipt cannot establish truth, comprehension or consent. Preserve source wording, exclusions, corrections and generated status. Accessible alternate/error/status paths must work during model/channel loss. No authority to message other people or collect audience data is inferred; actual populations, languages, comprehension and accessibility evidence remain open.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Cross-component mapping, complete outcomes and recovery
source_inspections.decision_reason: CETA crosses domain, store, model, kernel, broker, observer, custody, user-interface and migration boundaries. Mapping, identity, timing and partial effects are material; connected components or schema matches alone are not integrated outcomes.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Participants, flows, contracts, source/target meaning and ownership
Authority, transformations, delivery, evidence, privacy and control
Partial failure, reconciliation, compensation, migration and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Preserve source/transformed/mapped/delivered/acknowledged/reconciled/compensated states distinctly. Integrate real results into canonical legal next actions, not a disconnected demo. Unknown mappings and unsupported legacy categories require provenance-preserving quarantine. Durable recovery and evidence cannot depend solely on the failed participant. Data sharing or consequential new exchange requires exact authority; ordinary authorized contract implementation continues.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Typed programmatic ports and transport limits
source_inspections.decision_reason: Local typed ports, tool/broker operations, event/admin/recovery paths and provider interfaces expose or consume consequential programmatic operations. A REST server is not required for API obligations to apply.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Consumers, operations, schemas, versions and contract ownership
Validation, identity, authority, data, timing, limits and errors
Compatibility, abuse, partial effects, recovery, testing and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Model each actual synchronous/asynchronous/long-running/streamed/batch/admin/recovery operation with bounded schema, caller, current scope/policy, timing, truthful errors, retry/idempotency and evidence. Pagination and rate controls apply to operations that actually use them; do not invent a new web service. Implemented v1 record framing rejects hostile size/length before body parsing and preserves original bytes. Authentication, message envelope, generations, replay state, capacity and dispatch remain open.

source_inspections.bounded_subject: Whole-system assets, threats and enforceable controls
source_inspections.decision_reason: The system handles private data, identity, authority, keys, hostile inputs, models, tools, source history and external effects. Security is material across every entry, management, supplier and recovery path; no clean scan or pure unit test establishes whole-system security.

clause_allocations.original_clause_family: Assets, actors, assumptions, trust boundaries and attack paths
Prevention, detection, custody, cryptography, privacy and audit
Control loss, incidents, recovery, independent evidence and lifecycle

source_inspections.remaining_obligations: Retain the trusted-host and broker assumptions and separate administrator compromise from actual distributed protection. Malicious processes/repository inputs/models, forged approval, inherited handles, reparse paths, denial, replay and supplier mutation require real enforcement. Framing is one bounded pre-parser control; it does not authenticate senders, protect keys or prevent allocation before the caller invokes it. Incident/containment, residual risk, independent review and recovery evidence remain unresolved without accepting risk on the owner’s behalf.

bounded_control_evidence.limit: Schema acceptance supplies neither authentic peer nor current permission.
